description: Canonical replay of the v1.1 milestone audit-freshness gap: the v1.1 MILESTONE-AUDIT.md `audited:` frontmatter field predates the most recent v1.1 phase VERIFICATION.md filesystem mtime by ~21.91h, far exceeding the 1.0h threshold. The historical 'v1.1 13h-gap' label is from an initial planning estimate; the precise computed gap is 78890 seconds. /gsd-complete-milestone MUST refuse to archive in this scenario unless the operator passes --accept-stale-audit, in which case archive proceeds with a logged warning entry recording the stale-audit fact.

audit.frontmatter_field_name_drift_note: REQUIREMENTS.md TOOL-03 uses the generic English term 'audited_at' but the actual frontmatter field in v1.0/v1.1 MILESTONE-AUDIT.md files and in ~/.claude/get-shit-done/templates/audit-milestone.md:172 is 'audited:'. The upstream SDK port must read the 'audited' key, NOT 'audited_at'. The mismatch between the requirement-doc prose and the canonical implementation field name is a known drift; this fixture and the TOOL-03 spec record it so the port lands on the right key.
